summary: Preview the owner-indicated forward toilet recess, limited galley travel, exterior cockpit returns and onboard equipment documentation.
evidence: Owner-marked Open interior views indicate the toilet recess forward of the port bulkhead and the galley staying partly under the starboard cockpit even at the forward stop.
Owner identified open seams around the exterior cabin-to-cockpit junction. The molded returns and sheer closures follow the reconstructed surface geometry.

Restoration placement notes identify the port dashboard, opposing GPS/VHF faces, the aft port DC board and the port battery hatch. Stern ladder location follows the photographed transom. The original records and media are private.
